regions.today: Mostly cloudy this evening with some isolated showers possible. Winds will generally be light to moderate southerly.
regions.tonight: Cloudy and mostly dry at first. However, rain and drizzle will move in from the west as the night goes on, possibly heavy in places. A clearance will follow later. Temperatures will fall to between 10 and 13 degrees with light to moderate southerly winds veering northwesterly later.
regions.tomorrow: The last of the rain will clear the east coast early on to give a mostly dry day with sunny spells. Highest temperatures of 15 to 19 degrees, with light to moderate northwesterly or variable winds.
